Anshu Chandrakar Senior Product Owner | Business Analyst | Scrum Master | Immediate Joiner

+91 7999528588 •

anshu_sms@yahoo.co.uk •

Bengaluru,

SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst, Product Owner, and Scrum Master with 11+ years of experience delivering Digital Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Actions, API Integration, and Microservices transformation programmes across APAC, EMEA, and North America. Proven expertise in Agile Delivery, Product Backlog Management, SWIFT Messaging, BRD/FRD Documentation, Production Support, Stakeholder Governance, and Digital Transformation. Accomplished delivery of 10+ enterprise banking features across 8 global markets by implementing API-led modernization and Agile governance frameworks, leading to 25% growth in digital banking adoption and significant reduction in production issue resolution timelines. Recognized for combining product ownership, business analysis, and Agile delivery in a single role — driving digital adoption growth and multi-market transformation at Citibank Singapore and Broadridge.

EXPERIENCE

Broadridge Financial Solutions Business Lead – Corporate Actions

Bengaluru, India

Feb 2025 - Present

Improved sprint throughput and release quality through detailed corporate action lifecycle mapping, SWIFT MT565/MT566 validation, and close coordination with QA teams, recovering nearly 20% sprint capacity while minimizing recurring production defects.

Strengthened downstream SLA adherence via functional specification reviews, entitlement workflow checks, and custodian event processing governance across mandatory, voluntary, and mandatory-with-choice events.

Reduced production issue turnaround from 3–4 months to nearly 2 weeks through structured RCA practices, regression assessment, defect prioritization, and release oversight.

Built strong expertise in Corporate Actions processing using independent SWIFT event interpretation, developer walkthroughs, and support for institutional event management operations.

Citibank Singapore Assistant Vice President

Singapore

Jan 2023 - Apr 2024

Grew Citi's active Digital Banking user base by leading a 4-BA team to quality-assure every BRD, spec, and business case across 5+ strategic projects per quarter , directly increasing digital channel revenue and reducing branch servicing costs across APAC & EMEA.

Enhanced platform reliability and accelerated incident closure using Splunk analytics, backlog governance, and escalation management, lowering customer-facing issues by nearly 10%.

Automated JIRA reporting and programme dashboards, eliminating more than 200 manual effort hours per quarter for leadership and delivery teams.

Facilitated multi-market governance discussions, business case reviews, RAID tracking, and release planning with stakeholders across EMEA and APAC, ensuring zero missed stage gates.

Standardized sprint reporting and delivery governance models later adopted across wider Private Banking programmes.

Citibank Singapore Manager

Singapore

Dec 2019 - Jan 2023

Delivered more than 10 digital banking capabilities across 8 APAC and EMEA markets while overseeing backlog refinement, sprint coordination, and release execution.

Unified microservices-based demographic update journeys across Singapore, UAE, and Bahrain markets, decreasing Level 1 complaints and reducing branch dependency.

Directed transformation initiatives across Citi Mobile, Citi Online Banking, and Citi Eclipse platforms spanning APAC and EMEA regions, contributing to 25% growth in digital banking adoption.

Expanded Citi's digital product footprint across 8 markets on time and audit-ready by owning end-to-end BA delivery for 10+ features (Push Auth, Global Wallets, Cards, eBrokerage, Time Deposits, WorldLink Payments, W8-Ben, Wealth) driving regional digital adoption and reducing branch infrastructure reliance.

Guided a 5-member Agile squad across sprint ceremonies, user story refinement, and acceptance criteria reviews to maintain consistent delivery velocity.

Infosys Senior Associate Consultant

Pune, India

May 2019 - Nov 2019

Accelerated production incident closure and strengthened integration stability through RCA-focused troubleshooting, regression verification, and service optimization using TIBCO BW5 and SOAP UI.

Maintained SLA-driven support operations by coordinating distributed teams, escalation workflows, and continuity management across high-volume retail integration systems.

Lowered recurring production failures through detailed defect assessment and integration quality checks within Macy’s retail services landscape.

TIBCO Software Senior Associate Consultant

Pune, India

Jan 2016 - May 2019

Delivered more than 5 Open and Private APIs quarterly using REST, SOAP, JSON, and XML integrations supporting Citibank APAC and EMEA programmes.

Managed requirement workshops, BRDs, FRDs, UML diagrams, and API specifications aligned with banking transformation initiatives across Payments, Lending, Authentication, and Digital Banking domains.

Led delivery of regional transformation programmes involving Samsung Pay, Alipay, WeChat Pay, Russia CBOL, CFCA Authentication, and Virtual Remote Engagement platforms.

Established reusable API documentation standards, release governance practices, and integration guidelines that improved delivery consistency across programmes.

Received formal client recognition from Citibank within six months for rapid execution, stakeholder collaboration, and delivery excellence.

Wipro Technologies Project Engineer

Hyderabad, India

Feb 2014 - Dec 2015

Migrated legacy integration environments into SOA-compliant TIBCO BW5 services while reverse-engineering JCAPS workflows, achieving zero critical production defects.

Developed event-driven integration solutions using TIBCO BW5 and BusinessEvents supporting real-time logistics operations for FedEx platforms.

Increased testing effectiveness and minimized production defect leakage through Agile collaboration and QA enablement across TIBCO and LISA testing frameworks.

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Computer Science • GPA: CGPA 7.5 / 10

Apr 2009 - May 2013

SRM University

New Delhi, India

SKILLS

Banking and Financial Services: Digital Banking, Retail Banking, Corporate Actions, SWIFT MT565/MT566, Payments, Wealth Management, eBrokerage, Cards, Consumer Banking, API Banking, CoreBanking, KYC, Authentication, Account Management

Product & Business Analysis: BRD, FRD, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Backlog Grooming, Product Backlog Management, Requirement Gathering, Stakeholder Management, UAT, RAID Management, Traceability Matrix

Technical & Integration: MS Project, Splunk, Swagger, REST API, SOAP API, Microservices, TIBCO BW5, TIBCO EMS, SOAP UI, BusinessEvents, TIBCO Spotfire, TIBCO Admin, SQL, XML

Agile, Scrum & Delivery : JIRA, Confluence, JIRA Dashboards, Production Support, Defect Triage, Incident Management, RCA, Release Governance

Transformation & Strategy: Digital Transformation, API Modernization, As-Is/To-Be Analysis, Process Optimization, Governance Frameworks, Operational Excellence, Platform Modernization

CERTIFICATIONS

PSPO-I (Professional Scrum Product Owner) In Progress

Scrum.org

PSM-I (Professional Scrum Master) In Progress

Scrum.org
